name: insecure-smb-share-quiet-win
description: Practice-box helper (Windows): creates (or reconfigures) an SMB share $SHARE_NAME over $SHARE_PATH with Everyone = Full Control. This is the -ErrorAction Ignore variant of insecure-smb-share-win so a not-yet-existing share does not pollute $Error (the nakon rc trailer). Vars: SHARE_NAME (required); SHARE_PATH (required); DESCRIPTION (optional). Idempotent: an existing share is re-granted. Pairs with web_share_restricted.
